patches_added.name: Stop saving search history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding your new searches to the search history it saves on the phone. Searches you already made stay until you delete them, and this doesn't change what TikTok keeps on its servers. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Stop saving search history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding your new searches to the search history it saves on the phone. Searches you already made stay until you delete them, and this doesn't change what TikTok keeps on its servers. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_added.description: Makes Facebook's native dark themes use pure-black AMOLED surfaces.

patches_added.name: Clean Home feed
patches_added.description: Hides Home Reels panels, the Stories tray, and exact recommendation feed units.

patches_added.name: De-Vanced Settings
patches_added.description: Adds De-Vanced controls to Facebook Profile Settings.

patches_added.name: Disable all ads
patches_added.description: Blocks Facebook sponsored feed units, Stories ads, Reels ads, Marketplace ads, and Instant Games/Audience Network ads.

patches_added.name: Disable analytics and telemetry
patches_added.description: Blocks Facebook Analytics2, Falco, Papaya, QPL, XAnalytics, crash/trace uploads, and attribution trackers.

patches_added.name: Disable auto refresh
patches_added.description: Keeps the current feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes.

patches_added.name: Download Media
patches_added.description: Adds a native-styled Download media action to Facebook Reels and Stories menus.

patches_added.name: Facebook signature compatibility
patches_added.description: Keeps Facebook first-party navigation working after signing with the established De-Vanced key.

patches_added.name: Material You theme
patches_added.description: Tints Facebook's dark theme with the phone's wallpaper palette.

patches_added.name: Media quality controls
patches_added.description: Applies De-Vanced resolution choices to Facebook Reels and video Stories.

patches_added.name: Messenger install compatibility
patches_added.description: Namespaces Facebook's shared signature permissions so official Messenger installs beside a re-signed Facebook build.

patches_added.name: Open Marketplace on launch
patches_added.description: Opens Marketplace when Facebook is started from its launcher icon.

patches_added.name: Optimize Facebook
patches_added.description: Suppresses explicit GC stalls, trims extension caches under memory pressure, and reduces render-time reflection.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: Extends Facebook picture-in-picture to every supported video surface.

patches_added.name: Reels 2x speed
patches_added.description: Adds hold-to-speed and slide-to-lock gestures for Shorts.

patches_removed.name: Hide story ads
patches_removed.description: Hides the ads in the Facebook app stories.
